attributes.powers: For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d10+2. You may additionally recharge this card and expend any number of mythic charges to add 1d20 for each charge expended. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 20. If you succeed at the check, you may expend a charge to shuffle 1d6 random cards from your discard pile into your deck.
